statement: 6. Conclusion Our work initiates the study of policy optimization for SSP and systematically develops a set of novel algorithms suitable for different settings. Many questions remain open, such as closing the gap between some of our results and the best known results achieved by other types of methods. Moreover, as mentioned, one of the reasons to study PO for SSP is that PO usually works well when combined with function approximation. Our stacked discounted approximation scheme also does not make use of any modeling assumption and should be applicable in more general settings. Although our work is only for the tabular setting, we believe that our results lay a solid foundation for future studies on SSP with function approximation.

Conclusion Our work initiates the study of policy optimization for SSP and systematically develops a set of novel algorithms suitable for different settings. Many questions remain open, such as closing the gap between some of our results and the best known results achieved by other types of methods. Moreover, as mentioned, one of the reasons to study PO for SSP is that PO usually works well when combined with function approximation. Our stacked discounted approximation scheme also does not make use of any modeling assumption and should be applicable in more general settings. Although our work is only for the tabular setting, we believe that our results lay a solid foundation for future studies on SSP with function approximation. 13 C HEN L UO ROSENBERG
